name: Player Create: fresh member
description: CAP-02 / BR-02 / BR-03 / P-02: New member, main Player, and TWD/USD/PHP wallets are created.

queries.name: member
queries.sql: SELECT id, station_id, account FROM users WHERE station_id = 1 AND account = ?

queries.name: main_players
queries.sql: SELECT id, user_id, platform_id, account FROM players WHERE platform_id = 1 AND user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE station_id = 1 AND account = ?) ORDER BY id

queries.name: main_wallets
queries.sql: SELECT id, user_id, platform_id, player_id, currency, balance, freeze FROM wallets WHERE platform_id = 1 AND user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE station_id = 1 AND account = ?) ORDER BY id
